name: Sisterhood
overview: Scripture highlights the beauty and strength found in godly sisterhood through qualities of wisdom, kindness, and peacefulness. Proverbs portrays a woman whose ways are pleasant and whose speech is marked by wisdom and kindness, reflecting the character that should define sisterly relationships. The example of Martha welcoming Jesus into her home demonstrates the importance of hospitality and service within the community of believers, underscoring how sisterhood is lived out in practical, loving action.
